_readme: Partner outreach openers, one set per lead_type. Rendered server-side by
_render_template() and opened as a Gmail draft in the rep's own account -
{hook} is the one field needing judgment (a storm in their zip, an HOA's
roof age, a recent listing). It sits in its own paragraph so an empty hook
drops the paragraph instead of leaving a gap.
Voice matches the outreach-queue and estimate-followup skills: under 100
words, one ask, no hedging. banned_phrases is enforced by a test - if you
add a template that opens with 'just checking in', the suite fails.
